d:
Two unemployed slackers, Bhola and Ajay come across a newspaper advertisement about a missing elderly gentleman, whose estate is worth millions. They come across this male in the Hanging Garden Park in Mumbai, and decide to make him their paternal uncle and take him to live with them. Will they turn him in? What will happen next? Watch how the movie unfolds itself.
YOR - 1971
Star Cast - Navin Nischol, Archana, Om Prakash, Deven Varma, Aruna Irani, Lalita Pawar
Director – Hrishikesh Mukherjee
Producer – L.B. Thakur
Cinematographer - Jaywant Pathare
Music Director – R. D. Burman
